import SystemE
import Book1.Prop03.Main
set_option linter.unusedVariables false
set_option linter.unnecessarySeqFocus false

namespace Elements.Book1

set_option systemE.solverTime 30 in
theorem helper_1_20_simineq (p q r : Point) (PQ QR PR : Line)
    (htri : formTriangle p q r PQ QR PR) :
    |(q─p)| + |(p─r)| > |(q─r)| := by
  obtain ⟨⟨hp_PQ, hq_PQ, hpq⟩, hq_QR, hr_QR, hr_PR, hp_PR, hPQQR, hQRPR, hPRPQ⟩ := htri
  euclid_apply (extend_point_longer PQ q p (p─r)) as d'
  euclid_apply (proposition_3 p d' p r PQ PR) as d
  euclid_apply (line_from_points d r) as DR
  have h_iso : ∠ p:d:r = ∠ p:r:d := by sorry
  have h_gt  : ∠ q:r:d > ∠ p:d:r := by sorry
  have h_big : |(d─q)| > |(q─r)| := by sorry
  euclid_finish

end Elements.Book1

-- Generic triangle inequality: in triangle p q r, |qp| + |pr| > |qr|.
-- (The two sides meeting at p together exceed the opposite side qr.)
set_option systemE.solverTime 30 in
theorem helper_1_20_simineq (p q r : Point) (PQ QR PR : Line)
    (htri : formTriangle p q r PQ QR PR) :
    |(q─p)| + |(p─r)| > |(q─r)| := by
  obtain ⟨⟨hp_PQ, hq_PQ, hpq⟩, hq_QR, hr_QR, hr_PR, hp_PR, hPQQR, hQRPR, hPRPQ⟩ := htri
  euclid_apply (extend_point_longer PQ q p (p─r)) as d'
  euclid_apply (proposition_3 p d' p r PQ PR) as d
  euclid_apply (line_from_points d r) as DR
  have h_iso : ∠ p:d:r = ∠ p:r:d := by sorry
  have h_gt  : ∠ q:r:d > ∠ p:d:r := by sorry
  have h_big : |(d─q)| > |(q─r)| := by sorry
  euclid_finish
